votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 40 of 2025, celebrating the Utah Parent Teachers Association's Centennial Anniversary in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing the Utah Parent Teacher Association's 100th anniversary and its community involvement in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 70 of 2025, Parking Dimensions and Off-Street Parking Standards Manual Update.
votes.description: Amends Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to clarify driveway parking eligibility, expand tandem parking allowances, and update parking space dimensions to align with current engineering standards and state law (S.B. 181 and H.B. 368).

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 71 of 2025, Water Conservation and Land Use Element-General Plan Amendment.
votes.description: Adopts the Water Conservation and Land Use Planning Plan, formally integrating the City's land use plans with its 2022 Water Master Plan and updating the General Plan to comply with Utah State Code 10-9a-403 by the December 31, 2025 deadline.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 41 of 2025, Water Conservation Plan of 2025.
votes.description: Adopts the updated 2025 Water Conservation Plan developed in accordance with the State's Conservation Plan Act, establishing 5-, 10-, and 40-year water conservation goals and outlining programs and outreach strategies for implementation.

Approves three board appointments: David Warnock to the Citizens Compensation Advisory Committee, and Ralph Becker and Daniel Salmon to the Metropolitan Water District Board, each for terms ending December 2, 2029.
